# AI is only as good as its source

PitchBook brings AI + HI—Artificial Intelligence + Human Insights—into enterprise LLMs you already know and trust, giving you instant, trustworthy answers to complex questions. Access the industry’s most comprehensive, accurate, and timely private capital market data and research—wherever you need it.

### A new era of AI-powered data and research

- ### Clarify investment strategies

 Get the private capital markets data and research you need—deals, players, and trends—inside your favorite enterprise LLM.
- ### Analyze new opportunities

 Uncover prospects, investors, and networking opportunities by combining PitchBook’s authoritative data with world-class analysis.
- ### Make smarter decisions

 Stop relying on public sources with questionable accuracy. Power your LLM workflows with insights you can trust.

Enhance financial workflows

With the PitchBook Premium Connector, clients can use enterprise AI platforms to quickly uncover company data, source new opportunities, and synthesize industry research.

## Discover unrivaled company intelligence

Streamline your financial research journey from search to insight. Retrieve comprehensive data on a specific company, including overviews, financials, deal history, key personnel, and investors.

## Strengthen your competitive analysis

Use natural language search to compare and identify promising investment, M&A, and partnership opportunities with reliable financial and performance metrics.

## Seize emerging investment opportunities

Unlock PitchBook’s comprehensive Research Center and authoritative analyst insights with a simple prompt. Combine industry trends with company, deal, and investor data to identify and seize emerging opportunities.
